title: FederationRule
description:
Authorization rule binding an external OIDC identity to Anthropic.

Evaluates the match conditions and mints an OAuth access token for the
resolved target, scoped to a single workspace where the rule is enabled
(chosen by the caller at exchange time when the rule is enabled for more
than one). For rules enabled via `workspace_ids` or
`applies_to_all_workspaces`, the target service account must be a member
of that workspace (it is implicitly a member of the default workspace);
rules carrying only the legacy `workspace_id` binding do not enforce
this.

applies_to_all_workspaces.title: Applies To All Workspaces
applies_to_all_workspaces.description: When true, this rule is enabled for every workspace in the org (including ones created after the rule). `workspace_ids` is ignored at exchange time.

archived_at.title: Archived At
archived_at.description: If set, this rule is archived and rejects token exchange.

archived_by_actor_id.title: Archived By Actor Id
archived_by_actor_id.description: Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that archived this rule.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: CEL expressions extracting named values from claims. Not yet supported; always null.

created_by_actor_id.title: Created By Actor Id
created_by_actor_id.description: Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that created this rule.

id.title: Id
id.description: Tagged ID of the federation rule.

issuer_id.title: Issuer Id
issuer_id.description: Tagged ID of the issuer whose tokens this rule accepts.

issuer_name.title: Issuer Name
issuer_name.description: Issuer's display name at read time.

match.description: Conditions the verified JWT must satisfy for this rule to apply. All populated matcher fields must pass.

oauth_scope.title: Oauth Scope
oauth_scope.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes granted on the minted token.

target.description: Identity that tokens minted via this rule act as. Currently always a `service_account` target.

token_lifetime_seconds.title: Token Lifetime Seconds
token_lifetime_seconds.description: Lifetime in seconds of access tokens minted via this rule. Minted tokens are capped at `max(60, min(this value, 2 × remaining assertion validity))` seconds.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When this rule was last updated.

updated_by_actor_id.title: Updated By Actor Id
updated_by_actor_id.description: Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that last updated this rule.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: Legacy single-workspace binding. Prefer `workspace_ids` and the `/federation_rules/{federation_rule_id}/workspaces` sub-resource for managing workspace enablement.

workspace_ids.title: Workspace Ids
workspace_ids.description: Tagged IDs of the workspaces this rule is enabled for. May be empty for older rules that only carry the legacy `workspace_id` binding. Ignored at exchange time when `applies_to_all_workspaces` is true (the list may still be non-empty).

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Exact match against the `aud` claim (any element if array). When omitted, the JWT's `aud` must still equal Anthropic's expected audience for the issuer; setting this field overrides that default.

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: Exact-match `{claim: value}` pairs against top-level claims. Only string-valued claims can be matched; use `condition` for non-string claims.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: CEL expression over claims for logic the structural fields can't express. Must evaluate to a boolean and may reference only the `claims` variable; a constant-true expression (such as `true`) is rejected with 400.

subject_prefix.title: Subject Prefix
subject_prefix.description: Match the verified JWT `sub` claim. Exact match unless the value ends with `*`, in which case it is a prefix match. Example: `repo:my-org/my-repo:ref:refs/heads/main`.

BetaRuleMatch.title: RuleMatch
BetaRuleMatch.description:
Does the incoming JWT qualify?

All populated fields must pass; omitted fields are skipped. At least one
of `subject_prefix` (other than a wildcard-only value like `*`), `claims`,
or `condition` is required; `audience` alone is not sufficient.

service_account_id.title: Service Account Id
service_account_id.description: Tagged ID of the service account to mint tokens for.

service_account_name.title: Service Account Name
service_account_name.description: Service account's display name at read time. Ignored on writes.

BetaServiceAccountTarget.title: ServiceAccountTarget
BetaServiceAccountTarget.description: Bind to a fixed service account by ID.
